title: Loveless Community Challenge: Tough Love [9/25/2026]
details: From September 25 to 28, collectively get 10,000,000 kills while playing as Loveless to earn:
🎁 **Reward:** "Mint Chipset" Vault Hunter Skin usable by Loveless the Hacker

The all-new Vault Hunter Loveless the Hacker arrived as paid DLC alongside the Version 1.10 update, and she's been slicing her way through an onslaught of enemies with a lethal combination of synchronized biological and digital skills. Our next Borderlands 4 Community Challenge overclocks your incentive to play as Loveless, as you spread Contagion through her Plague Star, nail precision shots from the stealth cloaking of her Visual Paradox Nexus, and execute deadly Symbiosis attacks with her Malignant Construct all over Kairos.
If these Community Challenge conditions are successfully met, we'll share out a SHiFT code for the reward!
**Please Note:** To participate and equip the skin reward, you must own the Loveless the Hacker paid DLC. Unlock options:
• **New Players:** Purchase Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition (includes both DLC Vault Hunters C4SH and Loveless, Story Packs 1 & 2, Ornate Order Pack, and Bounty Pack Bundle).
• **Existing Owners:** Purchase the Vault Hunter Pack (includes both C4SH and Loveless) or purchase Loveless individually.

title: C4SH Community Challenge [4/2/2026]
details: C4SH Community Challenge - 500K Boss Kills [April 2 to April 5th]
If you can collectively defeat 500K bosses as C4SH from now through April 5, we'll drop a SHiFT code next week for the C4SH-exclusive "Like Vermillion Bucks" Vault Hunter skin.
